notes.content:

Hello, Guys!

As you well know, the game is constantly evolving, as we regularly show on our [b]Steam page[/b]. But did you know that we're also present on other social-media channels?

We'd like to invite you to [b]follow us also on other accounts[/b], the links to which can be found below:
- [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/CannonFoundrySimulator]Facebook[/url][/b],
- [b][url=https://twitter.com/CannonFoundry]Twitter[/url][/b],
- [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/cannon_foundry_simulator/]Instagram[/url][/b].

See you there!
